prompt:
Analyze this Performance page implementation and provide specific UX/UI improvement recommendations:

CURRENT PERFORMANCE PAGE FEATURES:
- Static page with hardcoded metrics (CPU: 67%, Memory: 82%, Disk I/O: 45%, Network: 23%)
- Basic grid layout with metric cards
- Simple page header with title and description
- No real-time data or interactivity
- No charts or visualizations
- No historical data or trends
- No performance optimization suggestions

TECHNICAL IMPLEMENTATION:
- Static JSX with hardcoded values
- Basic CSS grid layout
- No state management or data fetching
- No real-time updates or monitoring
- No performance data APIs

CURRENT UX ISSUES TO ADDRESS:
- Static data with no real-time updates
- No visualizations or charts for performance trends
- No historical data or performance history
- No performance alerts or recommendations
- No system optimization suggestions
- Missing mobile optimization and touch interactions
- No detailed performance breakdown or drill-down options

Provide 3-5 specific, actionable improvements focusing on:
1. Real-time performance monitoring and visualization
2. Interactive charts and performance trends
3. Performance alerts and optimization suggestions
4. Historical data and performance analytics
5. Mobile experience and touch interactions

Keep response concise and implementation-focused.
